tn-1Ppw.title: Landscape: Mediterranean to semi-desert
tn-1Ppw.summary: The climate ranges from Mediterranean to dry and semi-desert, depending on the region.

tn-1chu.title: Plate: black with white text
tn-1chu.summary: Plates are black with white writing. Military plates have a small flag on the left, visible on the dark green follow car.

tn-1mUD.title: Road: causeway with water on both sides, pipeline
tn-1mUD.summary: A causeway with water on both sides and a pipeline always on your west. It joins the island of Djerba to the mainland.

tn-2b6O.title: Sign: stop sign with Arabic and Latin text
tn-2b6O.summary: A stop sign with words in both Arabic and Latin script. Jordan and the UAE have similar ones. Israel and Palestine use a hand symbol instead of text.

differs.how: Uses a hand symbol instead of text

tn-2bxW.title: Sign: white direction signs, Arabic and Latin
tn-2bxW.summary: Direction signs mostly have a white background, with towns written in Arabic and Latin script in a distinctive font. The capital often appears even far from it.

tn-3AwV.title: Curb: red and white stripes
tn-3AwV.summary: Red and white striped curbs are common. Israel and Palestine have similar curbs, so check other clues.

tn-3PaS.title: Landscape: teal lake with flat shores
tn-3PaS.summary: A lake with teal-coloured water, slight hills to its south and flat land elsewhere around it. The city lies on its north-east side.

tn-3nZC.title: Follow car: light green Toyota
tn-3nZC.summary: A light green Toyota follow car found in the far north. It is never seen south of Hammamet.

tn-4ITK.title: Landscape: higher, greener hills on the east coast
tn-4ITK.summary: Between the capital and Hammamet looks like the area north of the capital, but with higher and more vegetated hills.

tn-64G4.title: Language: French and Arabic
tn-64G4.summary: French and Arabic are both common, often on the same sign. Arabic script is recognised by its lines and dots. The UAE and, rarely, Jordan use English and Arabic instead.

differs.how: Uses English and Arabic, not French
Uses English and Arabic, not French

tn-DECo.title: Houses: whitewashed with blue doors, many palms
tn-DECo.summary: Lots of palm trees and whitewashed traditional buildings with blue doors and windows. No follow car also confirms the island of Djerba.

tn-GWjM.title: Coverage: walking backpack at sights nationwide
tn-GWjM.summary: Walking-backpack coverage appears all over the country, even far from car coverage. It includes archaeological sites, forts, mosques and a Star Wars film set.

tn-IJ7u.title: Road: dark offroad over bright sand, east-west
tn-IJ7u.summary: A dark paved track through bright sandy soil running east-west. The east end has many prickly pears; the west end is very dry and barren.

tn-IOGg.title: Coverage: usually no follow car on the island
tn-IOGg.summary: Djerba is the one region usually without a follow car. Occasionally a white Mercedes or the dark green car appears.

tn-J8fI.title: Landscape: sandy hills in the flat south
tn-J8fI.summary: Occasional sandy hills on the main road north-west of Medenine. They stand out because most southern coverage is very flat.

tn-K7Lw.title: Landscape: very flat, dry, olive groves
tn-K7Lw.summary: The big middle region is very flat and dry. Olive groves are common and it gets drier further south.

tn-LVo2.title: Google car: escorted by a follow car
tn-LVo2.summary: In most coverage a second car follows the Google car, either right in front or far behind. Pan and zoom to find it. Several different follow cars exist.

tn-NNjW.title: Follow car: many different ones in the capital
tn-NNjW.summary: The capital has a lot of different follow cars all over the city. The light green Toyota can also appear.

tn-RpiN.title: Plants: olive groves in neat rows
tn-RpiN.summary: Olive tree plantations often line the roads, with trees in tidy rows over raked, weed-free soil.

tn-V6UL.title: Coverage: mostly the east coast
tn-V6UL.summary: Coverage is mostly on the east coast, from Bizerte in the north to Medenine in the south, in bigger towns and on main roads. The biggest towns and Djerba also have many side roads.

tn-VJOK.title: Landscape: desert-like, rubbish, small white rocks
tn-VJOK.summary: South of Gabes it turns desert-like, with more rubbish and small white rocks along the road. Olive groves are still fairly common, and a mountain range is often far to the south-west.

tn-WjkC.title: Road lines: white, edge lines dashed or solid
tn-WjkC.summary: Road lines are usually white and edge lines can be dashed or solid. A few roads in the big southern coastal city have yellow middle lines.

tn-deGy.title: Follow car: white Mitsubishi, white mirrors
tn-deGy.summary: A white Mitsubishi with white mirrors in the central-northern city of Kairouan. The dark green follow car sometimes trails it. Other white follow cars exist but none are Mitsubishis.

tn-g0dg.title: Route marker: white concrete post, coloured round top
tn-g0dg.summary: A white concrete marker with a rounded top that can be red, yellow or green. Each side shows the distance to the nearest town, and the road-facing side shows the road number.

tn-jiMW.title: Follow car: dark green Mazda, red-strip plate
tn-jiMW.summary: The most common follow car, dark green, with a military plate that has a red strip on the left. It appears from Hammamet down to Djerba.

tn-jkNV.title: Landscape: hilly fallow farmland north of the capital
tn-jkNV.summary: North of the capital is hilly Mediterranean farmland, with almost all fields lying fallow when photographed.

tn-mxuQ.title: Plants: lots of palms in one place
tn-mxuQ.summary: A big concentration of palm trees points to Gabes. Djerba has many palms too, but there the towns look more rural.

tn-qWoW.title: Google car: black with a thin medium antenna
tn-qWoW.summary: A black car with a medium-length thin antenna. The car colour is not always clear, so look for other clues.

tn-ydyn.title: Houses: doors and gates in traditional blue
tn-ydyn.summary: Doors, windows and gates are sometimes painted a particular traditional blue. It is found everywhere, but especially on the older island of Djerba.
